## How to resume (fresh session checklist)

1. Run `KICKSTART.md` Part 2 first (sync, keep-awake and the two watchdogs, the environment rules).
2. Read this file whole. It is kept short on purpose (KICKSTART 10(u)): the protocol, the standing orders, one state paragraph, the current queue, and the entries of runs that may still be in flight.
3. Read the latest `LOG.md` entry — the file's last heading, in windows (`grep -n "^## " LOG.md | tail -3`), never the file whole.
4. Read `BRIEF-WARNINGS.md` and the Index of `THEOREM-LEDGER.md`; read the `directions/` file of anything you are about to work on.
5. Harvest first (standing order 0): every entry under "Live/completed background tasks" that is not marked ✅ is a run to harvest from disk before anything new starts.
6. Then the "Current queue", top to bottom.
7. History — earlier states of the header, the superseded queues, completed task entries, the phase plan of August 2026, the findings log — is in `STATUS-ARCHIVE.md`. Grep it when a queue item or a charter points there; never read it whole.
